name: fs-retry.md
html:
shared\scripts\build\fs-retry.mjs

Bounded retry for fs operations that race Windows file locks.
Sourcesrc/shared\scripts\build\fs-retry.mjs
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

MAX_ATTEMPTS

Attempts before rethrowing — ~60s of capped backoff. Signature updates and indexer sweeps hold share locks for tens of seconds, and a deleted file stays open-blocked until the stale handle closes.

BACKOFF_STEP_MS

Backoff step in ms — multiplied by the attempt index, capped below.

BACKOFF_CAP_MS

Per-attempt backoff ceiling — linear growth stops here.

SLEEP_SLOT

Notification slot for Atomics.wait — Node permits waiting on the main thread (browsers forbid it), giving a true synchronous sleep.

sleepSync

Blocks the thread for ms via Atomics.wait; nothing ever notifies the slot so the call returns 'timed-out' after the full delay.

  • @param {number} ms milliseconds to block
  • @returns {string} Atomics.wait result — always 'timed-out'

retryable

Tells whether an fs error is a transient lock worth retrying.

  • @param {unknown} err caught error
  • @returns {boolean} true when the error code is retryable

backoffMs

Capped linear backoff for an attempt index — 50ms, 100ms, … up to the cap.

  • @param {number} attempt 1-based attempt number
  • @returns {number} milliseconds to wait before the next attempt

withFsRetry

Runs a synchronous fs operation, retrying transient lock errors with capped linear backoff. Non-lock errors and exhausted retries rethrow.

  • @param {() => T} op synchronous fs call to attempt
  • @returns {T} the operation's result once it succeeds

withFsRetryAsync

Async variant for fs-adjacent promises (rolldown bundle writes) — same retry policy, setTimeout backoff so the event loop stays free.

  • @param {() => Promise} op async fs call to attempt
  • @returns {Promise} the operation's result once it succeeds
